description:
## [1.1.0](https://github.com/Fuku856/smartlife-patches/compare/v1.0.0...v1.1.0) (2026-11-10)

### ✨ New Features

* **CI:** Play の新バージョンでパッチが当たるかを自動テストするワークフローを追加 ([52f9895](https://github.com/Fuku856/smartlife-patches/commit/52f98950c3b0971678266533ccf13bed2b41df9f))

patches.name: Disable telemetry
patches.description: Disables Firebase Analytics/Crashlytics and automatic page tracking. Works by turning off the app's own analytics feature flags.

options.description: Turns off Firebase Analytics and Crashlytics.

patches.name: Hide AI assistant
patches.description: Hides the "Hey Tuya" AI assistant added in app 7.0 (the home AI bar, the device-panel floating ball and the B2-gated entry points). This is a runtime toggle: it can be turned on and off in the in-app "SmartLife Patches" settings screen (long-press the settings button in the profile tab, or the Settings screen toolbar). Hidden by default.

patches.name: Hide ads
patches.description: Disables in-app ads: AdMob/PID banners and the Tuya marketing ad service. Works by turning off the app's own advertising feature flags.

patches.name: Hide home recommendations
patches.description: Hides the "おすすめ" (Recommended) cards on the home screen. This is a runtime toggle in the in-app "SmartLife Patches" settings screen. Hidden by default.

patches.name: SmartLife Patches settings
patches.description: Adds two ways to open the in-app "SmartLife Patches" settings screen: long-press the settings button at the top of the profile tab, or long-press the toolbar of the app's Settings screen.

patches.name: Spoof signature
patches.description: Keeps the original APK signature visible to the app after re-signing, so the app's integrity self-check passes instead of showing "integrity check failed" and quitting, and so email/phone + password login keeps working. Enabled by default because the app does not start without it.
